_about: Weapon and ammo cards: Material penetration, the hardest wall material the bullet goes through keeping at least half its speed and piercing (srp-026g/docs/notes/pierce_line.md). UI property 174 (st_srp_inv_material_pierce, not comparable: a detail row, no bar) and, on every round the item dictionary pairs with a weapon, a line 174 "<weapon dict_id>:<text key> ..." for each of its weapons, computed by content_edit.py (pierce_lines) from the files as the rows above leave them: the weapon's bullet_pierce x the round's k_arp against game.materials' armor of each tier's material, so a retune, a new gun or a new round follows. The weapons get no line (several configs are within 3 entries of the client's arena, tables.rs MAX_CONFIG_ENTRIES): the lobby reads a weapon's from its rounds. Last of the edit rows: build-content checks that the final files still make every line. Presentation only.
